## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.7 keeps scoped code-graph discovery responsive while background refreshes recover the latest requested work safely.

### Reliable scoped discovery

When a scoped code-graph refresh is scheduled or already running, compatible ready snapshots remain available for discovery reads. Agents can continue to inspect known graph evidence without waiting for background maintenance.

Large multi-repository Workset searches also preserve a full evidence-read window after routing, reducing false no-answer responses on slower hosts.

### Safer refresh recovery

Repeated refresh requests now converge on the newest scoped target, while interrupted or non-retryable maintenance is retained as clear recovery state. Strict current reads, path queries, and impact analysis still require exact scope evidence.

### Clearer scope boundaries

Persisted scope membership is normalized and validated before activation, helping distinguish compatible discovery evidence from operations that need an exact current graph.
